acc:doc.create/1.claim: A document is created as a draft and Frappe's validations apply.
acc:doc.create/1.observes: cli: in `org-with-hats-on-site`, the Director's `doc create Supplier --field supplier_name="Brightside Cleaning Ltd"` prints the new name; a member without the role exits ROLE_PERMISSION_DENIED and nothing is made.

acc:doc.get/1.claim: A document is read as the caller, with its status.
acc:doc.get/1.observes: cli: `doc get "Purchase Invoice" ACC-PINV-2026-00001 --json` prints docstatus and fields; a document that does not exist exits INVALID_INPUT.

acc:doc.submit/1.claim: An ordinary document posts to the ledger when submitted.
acc:doc.submit/1.observes: cli: `doc submit "Purchase Invoice" ACC-PINV-2026-00001` prints docstatus 1; read: `report run "General Ledger"` shows its lines.

acc:doc.submit/2.claim: A Payment Entry from the Safe is held, not posted, and the signer is named.
acc:doc.submit/2.observes: cli: in `org-with-held-payment`, `doc submit "Payment Entry" ACC-PAY-2026-00001 --json` prints held true, an approvalId and `awaiting`; read: no ledger line yet; after the signature lands it posts once.

acc:org.create/6.claim: The Organization's Safe is Companies House's company Safe for this founder.
acc:org.create/6.observes: chain: CompanySafeMinted names the Organization's Safe with the founder's personal Safe as founderSafe, at the minter's companySafeAddressFor. read: `org show` prints that Safe.

acc:org.feature.off/1.claim: A feature turned off refuses everywhere it can be reached and keeps its data.
acc:org.feature.off/1.observes: cli: in `org-with-site-features`, `org feature off projects --json` prints switching then off; `doc list Project` exits FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE; a browser request to a Project API route answers 403; `org feature on projects` then lists every project that was there.

acc:org.feature.on/1.claim: A feature turned on becomes reachable and shows everything that was there.
acc:org.feature.on/1.observes: cli: in `org-with-site-features`, after `org feature off stock` and `org feature on stock --json` prints switching then on; read: `doc list "Stock Entry"` works again and lists the entries made before it was off.

acc:org.feature.on/2.claim: WhatsApp cannot be turned on without CRM, and the reason is said first.
acc:org.feature.on/2.observes: cli: with crm off, `org feature on whatsapp` exits WRONG_STATE naming CRM; world: no row changes.

acc:org.member.grant/1.claim: A grant is a Director proposal, applied once it executes.
acc:org.member.grant/1.observes: read: `org proposal get` shows the grant's proposal waiting; after the second Director approves, `org member get` shows the member wearing the hat and the change reads `applied`

acc:record.export/1.claim: An export carries the lineage and every entry once.
acc:record.export/1.observes: cli: `record export --world town3 --out run.jsonl --json` prints the line count and lineage naming town1; the file's first line is the lineage and the entries follow in order.

acc:world.clock.warp/1.claim: A warp moves the chain and every site together and runs what fell due.
acc:world.clock.warp/1.observes: cli: in `world-frozen`, `world clock warp town1 --by 7d` prints worldNow a week on; a company's site shows its scheduled job ran for each day; `--by -1d` exits INVALID_INPUT.

acc:world.create/2.claim: A new world runs with its clock and a record that begins with its birth.
acc:world.create/2.observes: cli: from `empty-devnet`, `world create town1 --template empty --clock frozen --json` prints creating; `world show town1` then prints running, clockMode frozen, epoch 1 and recordHead 1; `record list --world town1` lists one `born` entry.

acc:world.show/1.claim: A world restored into another names its parent.
acc:world.show/1.observes: cli: in `world-with-snapshot`, after `world snapshot restore town1 m3 --as town3`, `world show town3 --json` prints parentWorld town1, parentSnapshot m3 and parentSeq.

acc:world.snapshot.restore/1.claim: An in-place restore returns the world to the snapshot and records it.
acc:world.snapshot.restore/1.observes: cli: in `world-with-snapshot`, after more commands, `world snapshot restore town1 m3`; the diff against the saved world is empty, epoch is one higher, the record has a `restore` entry and the earlier branch is listed as abandoned.

acc:world.snapshot.restore/2.claim: A restore into a separate world leaves the first world untouched and the two never see each other.
acc:world.snapshot.restore/2.observes: cli: `world snapshot restore town1 m3 --as town3`; both worlds list their companies on their own addresses; a command in town3 changes nothing in town1; the new born entry names town1, m3 and the sequence.

acc:world.snapshot.save/1.claim: A snapshot saves everything that makes the world and leaves it untouched.
acc:world.snapshot.save/1.observes: cli: `world snapshot save town1 m3 --json` prints the epoch and recordSeq; the world's record gains no entry but the save; `world snapshot list town1` lists it.

wfl:plugs.events.deliver/idempotent.claim: a second run with the same key (The site answers a repeated event key as already applied, and a transition already made is not made twice.) changes nothing
